images.label: Dark_Heart_Confrontation
images.prompt: A lone human figure,林烬, kneeling before a floating obsidian-black crystalline heart radiating cold violet energy pulses; cyberpunk/sci-fi style with intricate biomechanical details, dramatic low-angle composition, stark chiaroscuro lighting—deep shadows contrasted by sharp neon-blue data streams swirling around his outstretched hand as glowing code fragments materialize in the air; volumetric fog, metallic floor reflections, high-detail realism.

images.label: Vortex_Code_Battle
images.prompt: Lin Jin suspended mid-air inside a collapsing digital vortex, body wrapped in golden-lit bioluminescent energy tendrils from a hovering crimson dragon-heart; anime/sci-fi hybrid style, dynamic diagonal composition, dramatic backlighting from a distant radiant core, fractured black crystal shards flying outward; intense motion blur on debris, glowing circuit-pattern skin texture, deep indigo void background with floating binary glyphs and particle sparks.

images.label: Golden_Core_Awakening
images.prompt: Close-up of Lin Jin's hand gently touching a luminous golden tetrahedral crystal floating in serene zero-gravity space; sci-fi/anime style with ethereal soft-focus glow, centered symmetrical composition, warm volumetric lighting emanating from the crystal illuminating his determined face and faint golden veins pulsing under his skin; subtle lens flare, starfield backdrop with gentle light diffusion, ultra-detailed metallic-glass texture on crystal surface.
